DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 83 s. 2021 JUN 28 2021 DIR. ARACELI SAN JOSE OIC, DILG-CAR Barangay Center, Upper Session Rd. Cor. North Drive, Baguio City Dear Dir. San Jose: This has reference to the following communications: 1. Letter dated 23 March 2021 from Atty. Zosimo M. Abratique, in behalf of the proponents BAMARVA Office, City Market, Baguio City; 2. Your letter dated 14 April 2021 indorsing the matter to the Central Office for final disposition. In the aforesaid letter dated 23 March 2021 , Atty. Abratique is requesting for a certificate as to whether the "Proposed Ordinance providing Guidelines for the Master Plan for the Rehabilitation of the Baguio City Market" is within the local sanggunian's power to enact or amend and if the actions of the Sangguniang Panlungsod is considered as "favourable action" on the proposition. DILG-CAR has these initial positions: 1. As to whether the proposition is within the local sanggunian's power to enact or amend, you answer in the positive based on the provisions of the Local Government Code; 2. As to whether there was favorable action taken by the sanggunian Panlungsod, you also answer in the positive. You opine that the word "favorable' does not necessarily mean that the proposition is adopted in toto. Instead, youy believe that the fact that the sanggunian took cognizance of the proposition without categorically disapproving the same is considered a favorable action.

After evaluating the facts submitted by Atty. Abratique in his letter dated 23 March 2021, we found your position on the issue of whether or not the proposition is within the power of the Sangguniang Panlungsod to enact, in order. The same is correctly anchored on Section 447 of R.A. No 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code". Thus, the enactment of an ordinance providing guidelines for the master plan on the rehabilitation of the Baguo City Market is within the power of the Sangguniang Panlungsod. However, on the concept of "favorable action" on the initiative, we concur to the position of the letter sender that the annexes B, C, D and D-l , do not constitute "favorable action" of the legislative body as required by R.A. No. 6735, otherwise known as "The Initiative and Referendum Act". Those are proof that the Sanggunian, through the concerned Committees, has taken cognizance of the initiative. However, the thirty (30) day period had already lapsed without the Sanggunian's decision/action on the initiative. Per the documents submitted, the initiative is still at the committee level. The proponents may now invoke the power of initiative pursuant to Section 13(b), Part Ill, of R.A. No. 6735. Anyway, based on Section 15(c) of the same law, the initiative shall be cancelled in the event that the local legislative body adopts in toto the proposition presented at any time before the initiative is held. Insofar as the request for certification is concerned, may we submit that the Department does not issue such certification. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, e Authority of the Secretary: GAN MA Undersec ary for Local Government LLLS/84/17
